// diagnostic

E0420

`` `{name}` may be read before it is given a value ``.

What

`` `{name}` may be read before it is given a value ``.

Why

`` `{name}` was declared with `Type{ uninit }`, so no value is available until you write to it — this read could see garbage ``.

Fix

Write to `{name}` on every path before reading it (e.g. fill it via `mut {name}`).

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0420: tests/ui/uninit_read_before_write.stderr.

Error [E0420]: `x` may be read before it is given a value
  --> tests/ui/uninit_read_before_write.jet:6:11
    |
  6 |     print(x)
    |           ^
 Why: `x` was declared with `Type{ uninit }`, so no value is available until you write to it — this read could see garbage
 Fix: write to `x` on every path before reading it (e.g. fill it via `mut x`)
